card.name: Unit mg right after a dose number
card.fires_on: The unit 'mg' (or its last letter, or a similar unit like GBq) written right after a dose number in dosing instructions. It is strongest in recommended-dose statements and tables.

modes.label: mg after dose number
modes.description: The unit mg directly follows a number in a recommended dose, often before /kg, /m2 or 'per kg'.
modes.example: Recommended Intravenous PJIA Dosage Every 4 Weeks Patients less than 30 kg weight 10<< mg>> per kg Patients at or above 3

modes.label: Split or rare units
modes.description: The final letter of a unit split into pieces, or a less common unit such as GBq, after a number.
modes.example: or VYNDAMAX 61 mg (one 61-m<<g>> tafamidis capsule) orally once
